title: HR Advisor - 9 Month FTC
description:
What the role involves - 9 Months FTC
If you are a confident Employee Relations specialist who loves autonomy, fast turnarounds, and navigating fast-paced business evolution, we want to hear from you.
Joining us on an FTC basis, you will dive straight into the heart of our operations managing a varied ER portfolio with empathy and expertise, and keeping our policies sharp and compliant.

• Rapidly manage and resolve a high-volume portfolio of complex ER cases (including appeals and tribunal prep) with autonomy and speed.

• Act as a steady, expert guide for managers through fast-paced organisational changes, restructures, and consultation processes.

• Represent the company in virtual disciplinary, grievance, and collective consultation sessions to protect the business and champion fairness.

• Continuously refresh policies in line with evolving UK&I legislation and deliver practical coaching to boost management capability.

• Partner with the wider People team on forward-thinking projects to scale and sharpen our HR operations.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

• To thrive in this role, you bring a proven track record of managing a highly complex, sensitive ER caseload within a dedicated advisory or specialist environment.

• You pair in-depth, up-to-date knowledge of UK&I employment legislation with practical experience navigating change programs, organisational restructures, trade union consultations, and employment tribunal preparation. A CIPD qualification

• Behaviorally, you are a pragmatic problem-solver with a commercial, solution-oriented mindset focused on balanced outcomes rather than just quoting policy .

• You possess the stakeholder management skills to quickly build trust, establish credible relationships, and confidently challenge leaders at all levels.

• Fast-paced and resilient, you manage competing priorities with agility while helping others focus.

• You communicate complex legal advice with clarity, and you demonstrate the strong collaborative judgment needed to work seamlessly across the wider People function, knowing exactly when to escalate for the best outcome.

How we'll look after you
We take good care of our people - and that means more than just a pay packet. Whatever your role, you'll get a range of benefits, including:

•
25 days' holiday (plus bank holidays), as well as an extra day after you've been with us for three, five and 10 years. We also have a scheme to help you buy extra holiday if you want to.

• An extra day's paid leave each year to volunteer for a cause close to your community or your heart.

•
Big moment day - an extra day’s paid leave for a moment that matters to you - like getting married, moving house or welcoming a new addition to the family (human or furry!)

•
Bonus scheme - you'll get a stake in our success and a chance to add to your annual earnings.

•
Help saving for your retirement - we'll match your company pension contributions up to 6% and you can contribute through salary sacrifice.

•
Supportive and progressive people policies - we’re proud to have a range of policies to support people in their lives in and outside work, including enhanced family leave and policies to promote flexibility, inclusion and progression. We believe you shouldn’t have to wait to join us to know what to expect from us, which is why we share this overview of the policies we have in place to support families and carers. If there's something you want to understand more about, just ask - it won’t make a difference to your application.

•
A healthcare cash plan - giving you money back for a range of medical expenses and fast access to doctor's appointments.

•
Car lease scheme - you can buy a brand new electric or hybrid car through our leasing partner, and pay for it through salary sacrifice.

•
Wellbeing support - including a 24/7 assistance programme for you and your family.

•
Financial Wellbeing - Access Stream, our app for managing your finances, pay, rewards and benefits all in one place

title: Channel Account Manager, East
description:
Description
The Channel Account Manager will be responsible for managing and growing our channel partner ecosystem in the Eastern United States. This role will involve developing and nurturing relationships with existing partners, identifying new partners, and driving joint sales and marketing initiatives to expand Reco .ai’s footprint in the region. You will work closely with our sales, marketing, and technical teams to ensure our partners are well-equipped to sell and deliver Reco .ai’s AI solutions to their customers.
Responsibilities

•
Partner Relationship Management: Build, maintain and grow strong relationships with key channel partners (resellers, distributors, consultants, and system integrators) across the West + Central regions.

•
Sales Enablement Collaborate with sales and technical teams to equip partners with the tools, training, and resources needed to sell Reco .ai’s solutions effectively. Provide product demos, sales collateral, and technical training sessions.

•
Revenue Growth: Develop and implement joint sales plans with partners to drive revenue. Monitor and support partners to ensure sales targets are met and exceeded. Track performance, forecast sales, and report on channel KPIs.

•
Lead Generation & Opportunity Development: Work with the marketing team to generate and qualify leads for channel partners. Identify new business opportunities within the channel and align partners with these opportunities.

•
Strategic Account Management: Oversee the end-to-end process for key partner accounts, ensuring smooth deal closure, customer onboarding, and post-sales support. Act as the escalation point for major issues during the sales process.

•
Market Intelligence: Monitor and report on competitor activity, industry trends, and emerging market opportunities. Stay informed about customer needs and technology trends to keep Reco .ai’s solutions competitive.

•
Collaboration & Coordination: Serve as the primary liaison between Reco .ai and its channel partners. Work cross-functionally with sales, marketing, product, and customer success teams to ensure strong partner engagement.

•
Partner Training & Development: Organize and participate in partner onboarding sessions, certification programs, and regular training updates. Keep partners engaged and well-informed on product developments and best practices.

Requirements

•
Experience: 5+ years of experience in channel sales, account management, or business development, with a strong understanding of the software and/or AI industry. Proven track record of successfully managing and growing channel partnerships. Familiarity with sales processes, forecasting, and performance tracking in a partner environment.

•
Domain Expertise: A strong understanding of the cybersecurity ecosystem and relevant channel partners is required. Relevant experience recruiting, nurturing, growing, and maintaining Security Channel Partnerships.

•
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and build relationships at all levels. Ability to work independently and take initiative while collaborating in a team environment. Excellent organizational and time-management skills. Deep knowledge of the AI and/or SaaS space is a plus.

•
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).

•
Travel: Willingness to travel up to 50% within the assigned territory

title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) - Stuttgart
description:
Du hast erste Vertriebserfahrung und willst jetzt richtig loslegen? Bei uns bekommst du ein strukturierteres Onboarding, dein eigenes Gebiet, kurze Sales-Cycles und ein Team, das dich weiterentwickelt.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70% weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Du planst deine Woche eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Nachweisbare erste Erfahrung im Vertrieb, idealerweise mit Outbound-Anteil (Kaltakquise, Walk-ins, eigene Terminierung).

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert und organisiert.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Strukturierte Einarbeitung und praxisnahe Begleitung über die ersten Monate hinweg (Ramp-Up Programm).

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: Von Junior- über Senior- und bis hin zu Führungsrollen..

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die den Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Team-Formate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Design Lead

title: Program Manager, Safeguards Policy, Enforcement, and Threat Intelligence
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's Safeguards organization builds the policies, evaluations, and detection and enforcement systems that define and hold the limits on how Claude can be used. Within Safeguards, our Policy, Enforcement, and Threat Intelligence teams work as one org: Policy Design defines what is and isn't allowed across harm areas, Enforcement detects and acts on violations, and Threat Intelligence investigates sophisticated misuse and emerging threats.

That work runs across a lot of teams and moves fast. A single decision can touch model training, detection systems, product launches, legal review, and external communications. As the org's program manager, you'll keep all of it moving: tracking the portfolio across all three teams, running the processes that connect their work to each other and to the rest of the company, and making sure the right people are aligned before decisions land.

Your work will include the operating rhythm (planning, priorities, status, and decision tracking), launch and release readiness across policy, enforcement, and threat intelligence workstreams, and the processes that support how we share our work externally, including blog posts, threat reports, and other publications. You'll work closely with the org's leadership to spot risks early, clear blockers, and keep everyone pointed in the same direction.

This role is a good fit for someone who brings structure to ambiguous, fast-moving work without adding overhead, and who can earn the trust of policy experts, researchers, and engineers alike.

Important context for this role: some of the work may involve exposure to explicit content, including material of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature. It also may require late nights or weekend work.

Key responsibilities

•
Own cross-functional program management for the Policy Design, Enforcement and Threat Intel teams, keeping workstreams across harm areas on track and visible to leadership

•
Run the team's operating rhythm: quarterly planning, priority setting, status tracking, and a clear record of decisions, who made them, and why

•
Coordinate policy work with partner teams across research, product, engineering, legal, and communications, so dependencies are surfaced early and nothing lands on a partner as a surprise

•
Drive readiness for policy, enforcement, and threat intelligence work tied to model launches and product releases, including timelines, reviews, and sign-offs

•
Own the process for the org's external publications, including blog posts and threat reports, from idea through drafting, review, approvals, and publication

•
Identify risks, blockers, and resourcing gaps across the portfolio, and escalate them with a proposed path forward

•
Build lightweight processes and tools that make the team faster, and retire the ones that stop earning their keep

Minimum qualifications

•
Experience running cross-functional programs in a fast-moving technical environment, with a track record of shipping on time across teams you don't manage

•
Ability to bring structure to ambiguous work: breaking big goals into plans, owners, and milestones, and keeping them current as priorities shift

•
Strong written communication, including clear status updates, decision records, and summaries for executive audiences

•
Experience managing review and approval processes with multiple stakeholders, such as publications, launches, or policy releases

•
Judgment about when a process helps and when it's overhead, and a bias toward the lightest process that works

•
Comfort working on sensitive topics and holding high standards for confidentiality

That’s why we created what3words. We divided the world into 3m squares and gave each square a unique combination of three words. It’s the easiest way to find and share precise locations.

Over the last year, what3words has been used in 193 countries, and our monthly active users continue to grow at an impressive pace. Our tech is used by emergency services, delivery companies, eCommerce businesses, ride-hailing apps and NGOs, and is integrated into the navigation systems of millions of cars around the world.

title: Crisis & Escalations Executive - Bangalore (Contractual)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.

 As we continue to expand our operations across India, one of the fastest-growing bus markets in the world, we are looking for a proactive & detail-oriented Traffic Control Executive for our Bangalore location who will help us keep our services running smoothly, drive the company to the next level, and have the most direct influence on our success.

This is a real-time operations role, where you will be responsible for overseeing live bus operations, ensuring seamless coordination between drivers, hosts, and internal teams, and managing crisis situations calmly in a fast-paced environment. You will report to the Regional Operations Manager. This is an exciting opportunity to play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless operation of Flix's services, including real-time monitoring, issue resolution, and cross-team coordination!

About The Role

• Communicate with drivers and hosts via calls and messages to ensure smooth, on-time operations.

• Track and manage operational issues through Salesforce tickets, ensuring timely resolution.

• Handle crisis situations swiftly and decisively to minimize disruption to passengers and partners.

• Coordinate with Operations, Customer Support, and Global teams for end-to-end issue resolution.

• Collaborate via MS Teams and chat to enable seamless, real-time communication across teams.

• Monitor live operations and escalate deviations or incidents to the relevant stakeholders.

• Maintain discipline, flexibility, and teamwork while managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

About You

• Bachelor's degree holder, preferably with 3+ years' hands-on experience in customer service, intercity travel operations, or a related field.

• Team player with strong interpersonal skills and effective communication skills.

• Ability to multitask, problem-solve, and stay composed under pressure in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to thrive in a dynamic environment; flexible to work 24/7 rotational shifts, including weekends. However, when schedules are made your personal needs are taken into consideration.

• Basic Excel proficiency; experience with Salesforce is a strong plus.

• You are fluent in Telugu and English. Additional South Indian languages and Hindi are a plus.

• You are communicative, proactive, detail-oriented, and a dependable team player.

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

What We Offer

Opportunity to work in a rapidly scaling start-up.

Play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless execution of our intercity travel operations, real-time issue resolution, and cross-functional coordination.

Why Join Flix

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable. If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

title: Strategic Project Manager - QA&RA / R&D
description: Über uns Kijimea - Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen. Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 ( Kijimea Reizdarm ). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert - u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet . Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen. Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken. Für Dich klingt das spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kenn

title: Staff Technical Program Manager - AppEx
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

This is a hybrid role based in our Menlo Park or Bellevue office. You will split your time between working on-site with your engineering, product, and leadership partners and working remotely, giving you dedicated in-person time for planning, alignment, and the high-stakes conversations where being in the room matters.

AS A STAFF TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

- Define and own the program strategy for AppEx's highest-impact initiatives, spanning application surfaces, developer tooling, AI-powered experiences, and the underlying platform, from initial framing through launch and adoption

- Lead programs that cross AppEx sub-orgs (Applications, Notebooks, Native Apps, Drivers, AIML, Developer Platform) and extend into partner organizations across Snowflake, driving alignment where no single team owns the outcome

- Partner with Directors, Engineering Managers, Product Managers, and Principal Engineers to shape multi-quarter roadmaps, make tradeoff decisions explicit, and build execution plans that hold up under real-world complexity

- Drive cross-org decisions on shared APIs, integration points, and developer-facing launches that touch multiple Snowflake product surfaces

- Diagnose systemic friction in how AppEx plans and delivers, and design the operating mechanisms, including AI-assisted workflows, that improve engineering velocity and predictability across the org

- Represent AppEx programs to executive leadership with clear, data-backed narratives, recommendations, and escalations that drive decisions

- Raise the bar for technical program management across AppEx by mentoring other TPMs and establishing practices the wider organization adopts

OUR IDEAL STAFF TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER WILL HAVE:

- 8+ years of technical program management experience, ideally at a cloud software company, with a track record of owning complex, multi-team programs end to end

- Experience leading programs at organization-wide scope, where success depended on aligning several teams with competing priorities and no shared reporting line

- Deep familiarity with developer-facing products or platform engineering, and an understanding of what it takes to build great developer experiences and ship them at scale

- Strong technical depth: you work directly with engineers and architects, go deep on system design and dependencies when needed, and keep execution on track

- A proven ability to influence without authority across Engineering, Product, Design, and Go-to-Market

- Comfort operating in ambiguity, defining structure and direction where none exists and making progress before all the answers are clear

- Excellent written and verbal communication, effective with engineers, executive stakeholders, and everyone in between

- Experience with modern cloud-native software development, including CI/CD, release management, and API-first development

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

- Experience delivering AI/ML or generative AI products, such as LLM-powered features, agentic applications, or AI developer tooling, including the evaluation, quality, and launch-readiness challenges unique to them

- Working familiarity with GenAI

- Flexibilität: Profitiere von viel Flexibilität, z. B. indem Du Dir die Arbeit frei einteilst, aus dem Home Office arbeitest und 30 Urlaubstage im Jahr genießt

title: Distinguished Software Architect
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About The Role

Wayve is building the next generation of embodied AI for autonomous driving. As we move from developing our core technology to deploying it across multiple vehicle platforms, OEM programmes and Robotaxi applications, the complexity of our software systems is growing significantly.

We’re looking for a Distinguished Software Architect to help define how our software architecture evolves through this next phase of scale.

This is a highly cross-functional individual contributor role, working across our onboard software, AI, simulation, training and inference, product engineering and Robotaxi teams. You’ll work alongside some of our most senior technical and engineering leaders to ensure that the systems we build today can scale across the products and platforms we need tomorrow.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

You’ll operate across engineering organisations rather than within a single team, developing a deep understanding of how our software systems fit together and where architectural decisions in one area impact another.

You’ll work closely with senior engineers and engineering leaders to identify architectural challenges, shape technical direction and lead major changes that span multiple teams.

You’ll act as a trusted technical partner on some of our hardest engineering decisions, helping teams navigate trade-offs between immediate delivery needs and the long-term health and scalability of the overall system.

A significant part of the role will be leading through technical credibility and influence, creating alignment across teams and helping raise the bar for software design and engineering practices across Wayve.

POSITION OVERVIEW
Reporting to the Director of Engineering, the Sr Development Engineer will be responsible for technical diligence, design, energy performance forecasts, performance analyses and verification for hundreds of megawatts of PV and ESS development projects and operating facilities. S/he will support Project Development and Preconstruction project startup phases with hands-on design engineering, energy performance modeling, technical specifications data analysis and interpretation for Solar, Solar plus Storage and Standalone Storage projects up to 1 GW; and will provide technical support and inputs for PPA and EPC RFP Exhibit preparations. • Perform energy production forecasting modeling and analysis activities using PVSYST for all development projects and operating facilities and support technical diligence on site selection and project acquisitions.

• Implement energy production modeling analysis and provide modeling inputs to assist with the optimization of system designs for PV and ESS projects, to achieve targets for production yield, generating capacity, capital cost, financial returns, etc.

Software International (SI) supplies technical talent to a variety of clients ranging from Fortune 100/500/1000 companies to small and mid-sized organizations in Canada/US. We are currently hiring for a Senior Software Developer Agentic AI Experimentation & Prototyping for our global IT M&A client in the Toronto area.
Role: Senior Software Developer Agentic AI Experimentation & Prototyping
Type: Fulltime, Perm
Salary Range: $100,000 - $130,000 CAD as base depending on overall experience + bonus(total comp up to 150k) + benefits + other great company perks such as AI tooling and AI conference budget
Location: Remote - Toronto, ON, Canada
Remote within the United States or Canada (workday overlap from Pacific to Eastern time zones)
Role Overview
Were looking for a hands-on innovator who thrives at the cutting edge of whats possible with agentic AI systems. In this role, you will design and deliver experimental proof-of-concept projects ranging from one to four weeks in length that explore high-potential but high-risk ideas. The goal: to push the boundaries of agentic AI, surface breakthrough opportunities, and identify which concepts could become transformative products.
This position is ideal for a self-starter who embraces rapid experimentation, thrives in uncertainty, and believes that failure is always an option on the path to discovery. Youll be tasked with exploring novel approaches, testing unconventional ideas, and turning what if into working prototypes.
Key Responsibilities
Experimental AI Prototyping

• Rapidly design, build, and iterate on proofs of concept that integrate agentic AI solutions into real-world workflows.

• Explore high-risk, high-reward ideas with an eye toward surfacing scalable, high-impact opportunities.

• Treat experimentation as the core product focusing on speed, learning, and insight generation.

Creative Problem Solving

• Approach problems with an explorers mindset finding unconventional, creative, and novel ways to apply AI.

• Pivot quickly when ideas fail, extract learnings, and move to the next hypothesis.

• Blend engineering rigor with bold experimentation.

Agentic AI Expertise

• Experiment with multi-agent systems, orchestration frameworks, and emerging LLM tooling.

• Push the limits of AI-driven automation, human-in-the-loop systems, and autonomous agents.

• Establish patterns for safety, observability, and guardrails in experimental contexts.

Collaboration & Communication

• Share results both successes and failures openly to inform future bets.

• Partner with product and research teams to evaluate feasibility and impact of promising prototypes.

• Advocate for an experimentation-first culture within the engineering org.

Minimum Qualifications

• 5+ years building and delivering production or experimental software systems.

• Strong coding ability in at least one statically typed language (Go, Java, C#) and one scripting language (Python, TypeScript, Bash).

• Hands-on experience with AI/LLM tooling, including prompt engineering and agent frameworks.

• Proven ability to independently scope, prototype, and deliver fast-turnaround projects.

• Comfort with ambiguity, high failure rates, and rapid iteration cycles.

• Curiosity-driven mindset with a demonstrated track record of creative problem solving.

Preferred / Bonus Skills

• Prior experience working in labs, skunkworks teams, or exploratory R&D groups.

• Familiarity with multi-agent orchestration, autonomous systems, and reinforcement learning.

• Exposure to design thinking, rapid prototyping, or innovation sprints.

• Background in human-computer interaction or applied AI research.

Work Environment & Benefits

• Remote-first with optional hub meet-ups; hardware & co-working stipend.

• Flexible core hours (overlap 9 a.m. 3 p.m. ET).

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage in Canada & the U.S.

• Generous vacation, paid learning days, and annual budget for conferences or AI tooling subscriptions.

title: Principal, Commercial and Growth Analytics
description:
GeneDx (Nasdaq: WGS) delivers personalized and actionable health insights to inform diagnosis, direct treatment, and improve drug discovery. The company is uniquely positioned to accelerate the use of genomic and large-scale clinical information to enable precision medicine as the standard of care. GeneDx is at the forefront of transforming healthcare through its industry-leading exome and genome testing and interpretation services, fueled by the world’s largest, rare disease data sets. For more information, please visit .
Summary
You own the analytical answer to GeneDx ’s top-line questions: how volume grows, what drives it, and how it turns into revenue. Commercial leaders and the head of product come to you when they need an answer they can act on.
This is not a reporting role and it is not a request desk. It is closer to running a strategy and analytics practice for the top line of the company, with the leverage of AI agents in place of a team, a shared governance layer that keeps the numbers consistent and specialists you can draw on. Part of the job is answering what leaders ask. The other part is holding up a mirror: surfacing the issues and opportunities they have not asked about yet.
This is a senior individual contributor role. You will spend most of your week producing analysis, with AI agents as your hands, not directing people.
Job Responsibilities

• Own the answer to top-line questions. Where a question spans commercial volume and the revenue cycle, you are the single accountable owner, drawing on the RCM Analytics Director as the revenue-cycle specialist so leaders get one answer.

• Understand the commercial and product businesses well enough to see the problems leaders are trying to solve and bring structure to them: a well-formed problem statement and issue tree that separates what matters from what happens to be measurable.

• Act as the principal analytics advisor to the Chief Commercial Officer’s organization, and work closely with product leaders on the product questions Enterprise Analytics takes on

• Establish and run the operating rhythm with commercial and product leadership: integrate into their existing forums and put in place the mechanisms that keep analytical work focused on the right priorities and make trade-offs visible to the people making them.

• Lead engagements end to end. Orchestrate AI agents working within the team’s shared governance layer to build the analysis, apply your own judgment and standards to every intermediate result, and produce materials that hold up in front of an executive audience. The agents draft; you decide what is true and what it means.

• Drive the business to a decision and monitor the outcomes. Execution ownership and discipline stay with the business. Your accountability is that the decision was well founded and that we know whether it worked.

• Surface what nobody asked about. When the numbers say something about the top line that leaders need to hear, escalate as needed, and make sure the responsible leader hears it from you before anyone above them does.

• Build on the team’s governed set of definitions and methods, and work with the Director of Data Governance and business stakeholders to develop new ones where the work requires them.

• Contribute what each engagement teaches back to the shared repository, so the function compounds with reusable analyses, better methods, and sharper instructions for analytic agents.

Education, Experience, and Skills

• Director-level or equivalent senior individual contributor experience, typically ten or more years, in commercial strategy, growth analytics, management consulting, or strategic finance, with a record of owning the analysis behind decisions that moved a company’s top line.

• Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, scientific, economics, or business field, or equivalent practical experience. An MBA or an advanced degree in a quantitative discipline is a plus.

title: Creative Marketing Specialist
description:
Position Summary:
Under the direct supervision of the Marketing Manager, the Creative Marketing Specialist is responsible for developing and managing Native Forward Scholars Fund ’s visual brand, creative assets, website content, digital advertising, and marketing analytics. This position combines creative design, digital marketing, website management, and data analysis to strengthen Native Forward’s visibility, engagement, and organizational impact across print and digital channels.
The Creative Marketing Specialist leads the development of branded materials and campaign assets; manages website updates, SEO and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) efforts; supports paid digital advertising; monitors marketing performance; and translates organizational data and stories into compelling visual communications. The position works collaboratively with the Marketing Manager, PR & Digital Marketing Specialist, internal departments, contractors, and vendors to ensure marketing initiatives are strategic, consistent, accessible, and results driven.

• Support annual and ongoing marketing planning by analyzing performance trends, researching emerging digital and creative best practices, monitoring peer organizations and industry trends, identifying opportunities for increased visibility, and recommending improvements to marketing strategies and tactics.

title: Senior Performance Manager, Social Growth Platforms (all genders)
description:
The role

Meta is our core social channel, but the next leg of growth depends on what's around it. The 2026 ambition is clear: scale TikTok into our #2 social channel on incrementality-steered investment, and prove Pinterest, Snap, and other emerging platforms on the same evidence bar.

This role owns that diversification agenda end-to-end. You're the in-house expert on TikTok - its algorithm, Spark Ads, TikTok Creative Exchange, and the 2-3 day creative fatigue window that punishes slow teams. You also drive structured pilots on Pinterest and Snap: technical setup, account architecture, creative strategy tailored to each platform, and the incrementality tests that decide whether we scale or shut down. You don't run media for these channels in BAU mode - you build the playbook, prove the channel works, then hand a mature operation over to the broader team

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

• TikTok scale-up. Set TikTok as a native-first growth engine. Own account architecture, bidding, audience strategy, and the creative cadence the platform demands. Partner with TikTok directly - joint steering committee, beta access, TTCX program, Managed Services - to unlock funding and capability gaps.

• TikTok creative strategy. The single biggest lever on TikTok is platform-native creative. Define the briefing approach with the Creative Strategist and Influencer team, scale Spark Ads and creator partnerships, and build the iteration cadence the 2-3 day fatigue window requires. Push the team away from "repurposed Reels" toward TikTok-first concepts.

• Pinterest and Snap pilots. Run structured launch playbooks for each: signal infrastructure (CAPI, pixel, EMQ), account setup, creative strategy fit-for-platform, market selection, and a clean incrementality test (CLS or geo) before we commit a real budget. Same rigor for Reddit if/when it earns its slot.

• Incrementality and effectiveness. Design and run the conversion lift / geo experiments that determine which channels stay, scale, or sunset. Calibrate MMM with each result.

• Channel-by-channel measurement. Own the data foundation across emerging channels - overlap analysis with Meta, audience cannibalization, true incremental CAC. Build the case (or the kill memo) with evidence, not platform-reported numbers.

• Future-channel scouting. Stay ahead on what's next - Reddit, ChatGPT/Copilot Ads, retail media, emerging short-video platforms. Maintain a prioritized backlog and a clear bar for what earns a pilot slot.

• Handover and scaling. Once a channel is proven and operationalized, transition BAU execution to the broader paid social team with documented playbooks, while staying accountable for the next bet.

What you’ll bring

• 5+ years in paid social or performance marketing, with deep hands-on TikTok Ads Manager fluency at a high-spend D2C, subscription, or e-commerce business. You've personally scaled a TikTok account from low single-digit % of spend into a meaningful contributor.

• Working knowledge of Pinterest Ads Manager and Snap Ads Manager - or a credible track record of taking a new platform from zero to scale, fast.

• Strong incrementality and experimentation muscle - you can design a CLS or geo test, defend the methodology, and read the result without spinning it.

• Sharp creative instinct for short-form video and platform-native content. You know why a TikTok hook is different from a Reels hook, and can brief and review against that.

• Comfortable building from scratch - pixel setup, account architecture, partner relationships, internal stakeholder buy-in. This role has more zero-to-one work than steady-state.

- Support on intellectual property matters and litigious matters as they arise

- Take on company secretarial and governance work

- Support corporate and transactional work, including KYC / due diligence requests and diligence reviews on corporate projects

- Work closely with the rest of the Legal team to deliver timely, first-class legal support

HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT

- You'll help drive the business forward by taking the initiative and embracing work beyond your comfort zone

- You'll get to grips with new markets and financial products, bringing energy and curiosity to each new challenge

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- NQ - 2PQE, qualified in England & Wales, or in another common law jurisdiction with relevant UK experience

• Manage internal contributors and contractors, ensuring deadlines and quality.

• Launch 6-8 major campaigns that generate a measurable pipeline.

title: Office Manager
description:
OUR MISSION:

At Sunrise Robotics, we are dedicated to augmenting humanity through intelligent robotics. Our mission is to elevate the world of manufacturing by introducing intelligent, flexible robots that enhance human capabilities and existing machinery, ushering in the next era of production at higher quality, with less waste, and lower cost.

OUR VISION:

We see a future where every element of manufacturing, from design to assembly, is optimised with intelligent automation. Our vision is to integrate flexible robotic solutions, based on generic hardware and advanced software/AI capabilities, into manufacturing, particularly in small and medium-sized enterprises, to make automation economically viable and accessible, for all sizes of manufacturers. We are not just building robots; we are creating the strategically crucial components for autonomous, intelligent agents of the future.

The Role

Sunrise Robotics is hiring an Office Manager to run our Ljubljana offices and support our people operations. Our team works across two office floors and a lab, and you make sure every part of it runs smoothly, every day. About 20% of your time goes to people operations: you are the person new hires and colleagues come to, from onboarding to everyday questions. This role suits someone with a sharp eye for detail, who notices when something is out of place and puts it right. If you care about creating a workplace where people can do their best work, you will love this role.

What You'll Do

- Keep the offices running. You are the first contact for the landlord and handle access, keys and alarms, repairs, cleaning, and security and fire safety. You receive and route every delivery, prepare outbound shipments with the right labels, packing lists and customs documents, and coordinate deliveries to the lab.

- Manage vendors and spend. Own relationships with cleaners, maintenance and other service providers. Research suppliers, collect quotes, order within the office budget, and keep receipts and documents in order.

- Make it a great place to work. Kitchen and consumables, furniture and equipment, visitors and reception, relations with our neighbours, and the everyday standard of a space people are proud to work in.

- Run events and travel. Plan and run company onsite weeks for around 50 people, team events and gifts, and travel and accommodation for the team.

- Support our people. Spend about 20% of your time on people operations: onboarding and new-hire support, employee questions, our HR system, health and safety, and student and contractor administration.

- Build the playbooks. Turn recurring work into simple processes, templates and automations, and set the standard for how things are done.

What You'll Need

- At least two years in office management, facilities, executive support or operations coordination, ideally in a fast-paced, fast-growing company.

- Fluent English, spoken and written. It is our company language and you will use it every day. Slovenian is a plus, as it helps with the landlord, vendors and local administration.

- Attention to detail: things out of place bother you, and you fix them without being asked.

- Ownership: you get things done. You spot problems before they arise and fix them without asking permission.

- Composure: when three things land at once, you prioritise and handle them calmly.

- Confidence with Google Workspace, Slack and Notion, and hands-on use of AI tools to save time on routine work.

- Full-time availability on-site in Ljubljana.

What Makes You Stand Out

- Processes, templates or automations you built that others still use.

- A hospitality or customer service background: you know how to make people feel welcome.

- Event planning at scale, such as offsites or conferences.

- Experience with shipping documentation and customs.

- HR administration or onboarding experience.

- Interest in AI and robotics.

Why Us

- Real ownership: you run a whole function from day one, with a budget

This role offers the opportunity to work across software, hardware, and experimental-system boundaries while contributing to a strong engineering culture within the Darmstadt Software Department. title: Senior Software Engineer (f/m/d) Block Storage Provisioning
description:
About IONOS

At IONOS, we don't just manage servers - we shape the digital future for more than 6.2 million customers worldwide with our solutions. As Europe's leading hosting provider and a pioneer in independent cloud solutions, we are building next-generation infrastructure - from sovereign cloud architectures and high-performance GPU clusters to integrated AI automation tools.

What drives us is digital sovereignty for Europe and real impact for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) as well as large enterprises. We work in agile teams, rely on transparent structures, and believe that excellence and innovation only emerge through true team spirit.

Ready for your next step? Become part of IONOS and grow with us.

IONOS Cloud runs on highly available, redundant block storage that must be provisioned quickly, reliably and at scale. You own the software behind it and build on the Linux storage stack instead of reinventing it. Your focus is provisioning.

Tasks

• Maintain and improve our existing block storage provisioning

• Design and develop the next generation of our storage provisioning

• Add monitoring and alerting for the provisioning workflow to detect failures early

• Make provisioning robust against failures and safe to retry

• Design and implement provisioning that keeps storage highly available and redundant, including failover

• Analyze and resolve complex issues across the storage stack, from the Linux kernel up to the provisioning layer

• Migrate from legacy components step by step, without breaking existing users

Qualifications

• Expert Go skills and several years of professional development experience

• Deep knowledge of Linux, including the kernel, block storage, software RAID (MD), LVM and network block devices (NBD, RNBD)

• Experience with VMs (libvirt, QEMU, cloud-init), building VM images and developing Kubernetes Operators

• Working knowledge of C, enough to read and debug low-level code

• Fluency with Git, Docker, shell and CI/CD, including GitOps workflows (for example ArgoCD)

• Experience with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana) to monitor provisioning and troubleshoot issues

• Experience building highly available, redundant systems, including replication, failover and distributed-systems fundamentals (idempotency, retries, consistency, failure handling)

• Affinity to cloud environments and to automating infrastructure provisioning

• Daily use of AI coding assistants (for example Claude) in your development work

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and a structured, independent way of working in a team

Benefits

• Hybrid working model.

• Flexible working hours through trust-based working hours.

• At some locations a subsidized canteen and various free drinks.

• Modern office space with very good transport connections.

• Various employee discounts for activities and products.

• Employee events such as summer and winter parties, as well as workshops.

• Numerous training and development opportunities.

• Various health offers, such as sports and health courses.

 
Application Note

We value diversity and welcome all applications - regardless of, for example, gender, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion, disability, age as well as sexual orientation and identity, physical characteristics, marital status or any other irrelevant factor subject to applicable law.
